name: op_resize_mixed_canvas_bg_system_dpi252
description: ROTATION TO LANDSCAPE - a root (canvas) background over a MIXED resize (wider, shorter). The Android emulator run 45797870060 (AzWidgets, dpi 252 = 2.625) showed the page's white only up to the OLD width after the rotation while a render of the same list from scratch was right, and the presents wrote every row. The harness clears to white, so a page background that is NOT white is what tells 'cleared and never repainted' from 'painted'. Probe, not yet a ruling: expect red if the strip's canvas rect is not painted.

css: body  { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; color: black; background-color: system:window-background; display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; }
#root { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex-grow: 1; min-height: 0; }
.scroller { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow-y: auto; flex-grow: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 12px; }
.field { width: 100%; height: 36px; background: white; border: 1px solid #888; }
